independentReview: Root has independently accepted three specific medium repair views; final batch/cleft independent verdict is separate and pending at this record creation.
scope: Four B02 worlds across three grades plus cleft-tableland edge-only recheck across three grades, one requested seed 20261005. Normal finite FOV/light/camera, bare training kit and real WASD from spawn. Full static floor used only for QA route planning. No health, enemy, fog, clock or position edits. Only the listed stills are art-reviewed; videos retained but not called continuous play or listening.

worlds.finding: 顺纤床的两处横接和独立冷蓝断束可分；三档照见的细岸保持连续，暖床/蓝实体/绿色侵蚀各有职责。
worlds.limits: 仅两接近处和东床断束；视野外的岸、整条返路和全部敌情未审。

worlds.finding: 弯厚唇与冷蓝粗床、真实凹湾边界可辨，北侧返路保持开放；三档近脚边未退成地面斑。
worlds.limits: 斜岸仍跟随真实8px地形形成阶梯，此次修复的是逐格独立锥峰；不签完整壳背及黑处。

worlds.finding: 两处灰露层已收回各自短断肩旁；原覆盖整床的长直灰粉分色线消除，三床转折与两颈仍可辨。
worlds.limits: 保留第一低母面与真实片状外沿；低层为可走表面，不能把色线等同碰撞。只签已照见短肩/颈口与局部裸床。

worlds.finding: 长直岸从规则锥齿改为连续窄厚边，紫胶薄尾与冷蓝裸床相接；三档回连处和近身终止岸可辨。
worlds.limits: 面朝终端及追加侧视都受真实缺地遮挡，只证明近足窄岸/可走床分界，未展示整个端部外壁；不是完整双袋搜撤证明。

affectedPriorWorld.finding: 两颈受影响岸沿三档复审，连续母面及裸床/缺地的近身区分保持；绿色侵蚀增加时未重新形成规则锥齿。
affectedPriorWorld.limits: 只复查共享地沿变动；不把3103原图改标3105，不重新签其整个关卡资格。

history.retention: All previous reports, screenshots and source identities preserved. New evidence addresses the stated visible defects only.

limitations: No full route, full enemy set, all seed, search/extraction, economic balance, long-run fatigue or listening claim.
Actual keypress positions and live phase timing differ slightly; these are comparable intended stations, not pixel-identical camera/time.
Native world coordinates and 20px support are not inferred from bright outlines; collision protection is separately tested.
Dark/unlit surfaces and the hidden outer sides of end banks are not signed.
